_notes.purpose: Accepted ERC/DRC counts from the CI KiCad image (kicad/kicad:10.0.2). Gate is a ratchet: errors fail on ANY change up or down; warnings fail on increase. This is not 'accepting errors' — every entry is a reviewed, documented false-positive or deliberate design choice, and the strict gate forces a conscious review before the set can change. Refresh only inside the CI image via --update-baseline, in the same commit as the design change that justifies it.
_notes.regenerated: 2026-06-14, board v2 (ESP32-C3 redesign): generated in kicad/kicad:10.0.2; the bench (10.0.3) produces identical counts.
_notes.erc:warning:lib_symbol_mismatch: Vendored/custom symbols (AHT20, ESP32-C3, USB-C) carry metadata that differs from stock library symbols not installed in the container. Cosmetic.
_notes.error:courtyards_overlap: H1 mounting hole vs the ESP32-C3 (U3) antenna keepout — same top-left corner as v1; nylon-screw mitigation keeps metal out of the antenna near-field (bring-up.md).
_notes.error:items_not_allowed: The H1 mounting hole (NPTH pad + footprint) sits in U3's antenna keepout rule area. Same accepted H1/antenna trade as courtyards_overlap.
_notes.warning:lib_footprint_mismatch: Vendored/custom footprints (XKB USB-C, AHT20 sensor, ESP32-C3) differ from stock KiCad lib metadata; those libraries aren't installed in the container. Cosmetic.
_notes.warning:silk_edge_clearance: A little silk text grazes the board-edge clearance band on this dense board. Cosmetic; trimmed by the fab anyway.
_notes.warning:silk_over_copper: Dense v2 routing: reference silk sits over F.Cu copper in places. Solder-mask-isolated, no electrical or assembly effect (rose 35->50 vs v1 because v2 packs more copper after the cost-down re-layout).
_notes.warning:silk_overlap: Cosmetic silk-on-silk on a dense board (35, down from v1's 44 after the auto-placed-reference silk pass).
_notes.drc_unconnected: GENUINELY ZERO — the board is fully routed, GND poured on both layers with per-pad solid connection + stitched/island-tied vias. (v1's baseline accepted 7 here; v2 closes them all.)
_notes.drc_parity: Name/metadata residue (auto-named 2-pin nets, dual-label net-name picks, a couple of stale PCB LCSC fields). Electrically inert — the golden netlist + POLARITY table verify true connectivity, and fab outputs are netlist-driven. Down from v1's 71 after the v2 rewire.
